shortDescription: Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency by market value, was up by around 2.14% at $60,192.07 at 10:16 a.m. ET (1516 GMT) on Saturday.On Friday, bitcoin broke below $57,742, the lowest since September 2024.
